import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sensor_types = df['sensor_type'].value_counts().head(4).index
df_filtered = df[df['sensor_type'].isin(sensor_types)]
for sensor in sensor_types:
    data = df_filtered[df_filtered['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax1.scatter(data['megapixels'], data['price_usd'], alpha=0.6, s=50, label=sensor)
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Camera Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sensor Type', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Brand distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
brand_counts = df['brand'].value_counts().head(8)
ax2.barh(range(len(brand_counts)), brand_counts.values, color='steelblue')
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(brand_counts)))
ax2.set_yticklabels(brand_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax2.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Top 8 Camera Brands', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Average price by body type
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
body_avg_price = df.groupby('body_type')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(body_avg_price))
ax3.bar(range(len(body_avg_price)), body_avg_price.values, color=colors)
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(body_avg_price)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(body_avg_price.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Average Price by Body Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. 4K Video capability over time
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
video_by_year = df.groupby('model_year')['has_video_4k'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
video_by_year['percentage'] = (video_by_year['sum'] / video_by_year['count']) * 100
ax4.plot(video_by_year.index, video_by_year['percentage'], marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=6, color='#e74c3c')
ax4.fill_between(video_by_year.index, video_by_year['percentage'], alpha=0.3, color='#e74c3c')
ax4.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('% with 4K Video', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('4K Video Adoption Over Time', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 5. Weight distribution by sensor type
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
sensor_for_box = df['sensor_type'].value_counts().head(4).index
df_box = df[df['sensor_type'].isin(sensor_for_box)]
box_data = [df_box[df_box['sensor_type'] == s]['weight_grams'].values for s in sensor_for_box]
bp = ax5.boxplot(box_data, labels=sensor_for_box, patch_artist=True)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], sns.color_palette('Set2', len(sensor_for_box))):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
ax5.set_xticklabels(sensor_for_box, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax5.set_ylabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Weight Distribution by Sensor Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 6. ISO capabilities over time
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
iso_by_year = df.groupby('model_year')['max_iso'].agg(['mean', 'median', 'max'])
ax6.plot(iso_by_year.index, iso_by_year['mean'], marker='o', linewidth=2, label='Mean', color='#3498db')
ax6.plot(iso_by_year.index, iso_by_year['median'], marker='s', linewidth=2, label='Median', color='#2ecc71')
ax6.plot(iso_by_year.index, iso_by_year['max'], marker='^', linewidth=2, label='Max', color='#9b59b6', alpha=0.7)
ax6.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=11)
ax6.set_ylabel('Max ISO', fontsize=11)
ax6.set_title('Maximum ISO Performance Trends Over Time', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax6.legend(fontsize=10)
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3)
ax6.set_yscale('log')

plt.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
